hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: A string of even length is an anti-palindrome if s[i] does not equal s[n - 1 - i] for all i.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Sort s initially to minimize lexicographically. If any character frequency exceeds n // 2, no valid anti-palindrome can be formed.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: If middle characters match, find the first position i past the middle block of identical characters and greedily swap to resolve palindrome violations.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting string characters followed by two-pointer conflict resolution.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all permutations takes factorial time O(n!).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort greedily and resolve middle reflection conflicts in linear time.
